docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
The AI Project Manager is an intelligent system designed to assist software development teams by analyzing communication and extracting meaningful project insights.

The system analyzes conversations from Slack workspaces and automatically identifies:

  • Tasks
  • Blockers
  • Updates
  • Urgent issues

These insights are stored in a knowledge base and can be queried using an AI chatbot.

docs.text:

F --> G[AI Chatbot]

docs.title: 1. Overview
docs.text:
Build an AI Project Manager Bot for Slack that:

  • Conducts daily standups
  • Collects team updates
  • Uses an LLM to categorize updates into:
    • Tasks
    • Blockers
    • Daily Updates
  • Stores structured information in PostgreSQL
  • Provides an AI chatbot interface that answers project questions by querying the database.

The chatbot interacts directly inside Slack channels.

docs.title: Step 1 -- AI PM Bot Posts Standup Message
docs.text:
At 9:30 AM, the AI bot posts a standup prompt.

Example:

The following team members were assigned tasks:

Aarushi → Task1

Akshita → Task2

Rudraksh → Task3

Manav → Task4

Please mention your updates in this thread.

Slack returns:

  • channel_id
  • thread_ts (thread timestamp)

This thread ID is stored.

docs.title: 12. AI Chatbot Architecture
docs.text:
When a user asks a question in Slack:

@ai-pm-bot What blockers does Aarushi have?

Slack sends an app_mention event to the backend.

docs.title: 13. Chatbot Processing Flow
docs.text:
sequenceDiagram

participant User
participant Slack
participant Backend
participant LLM
participant Database

User->>Slack: Ask question
Slack->>Backend: Event API
Backend->>LLM: Send user query

LLM->>Backend: Tool call decision

Backend->>Database: Query data

Database->>Backend: Return results

Backend->>LLM: Provide tool result

LLM->>Backend: Final answer

Backend->>Slack: Send response

Slack->>User: Display message

docs.title: 14. LLM Tool Calling
docs.text:
The chatbot uses tools to query the database.

Available tools:

get_tasks(user_name)

get_blockers(user_name)

get_updates(user_name)

docs.title: Example Tool
docs.text:
get_blockers("Aarushi")

SQL Query:

SELECT content FROM blockers JOIN users ON users.id = blockers.user_id WHERE users.name = 'Aarushi' AND status='open'

docs.title: 15. Example Chat
docs.text:
User:

@ai-pm-bot What is Aarushi working on?

LLM Tool Call:

get_tasks("Aarushi")

Database Result:

API integration testing

LLM Final Answer:

Aarushi is currently working on:

• API integration testing\ Status: In progress

docs.title: 16. Slack Response
docs.text:
Backend sends the response to Slack.

Slack API:

chat.postMessage

Example request:

{ "channel":"C123", "thread_ts":"1712343434", "text":"Aarushi is currently working on API integration testing" }

docs.title: Database Schema
docs.text:
The AI Project Manager system stores project, workspace, and communication data in a relational database.

The database schema is designed to support:

  • Project and workspace management
  • Slack channel integration
  • Communication intelligence
  • Message storage and analysis

docs.title: Users Table
docs.text:
Stores information about system users such as administrators, developers, and freelancers.

Column Name Data Type Description user_id UUID (PK) Unique identifier for the user slack_id UUID (PK) Unique identifier for the user name VARCHAR Full name of the user email VARCHAR User email address role VARCHAR Role (Admin, Developer, Freelancer) created_at TIMESTAMP User creation time

docs.title: Workspace Table
docs.text:
Represents Slack workspaces connected to the system.

Column Name Data Type Description workspace_id UUID (PK) Unique workspace identifier workspace_name VARCHAR Name of the Slack workspace slack_workspace_id VARCHAR Slack workspace identifier created_by UUID (FK) User who created the workspace created_at TIMESTAMP Creation timestamp

docs.title: Project Table
docs.text:
Stores project information created by administrators.

Column Name Data Type Description project_id UUID (PK) Unique project identifier project_name VARCHAR Name of the project description TEXT Project description workspace_id UUID (FK) Associated workspace created_by UUID (FK) User who created the project created_at TIMESTAMP Creation timestamp

docs.title: Project Channel Mapping Table
docs.text:
Maps projects to Slack channels where communication occurs.

Column Name Data Type Description mapping_id UUID (PK) Unique mapping identifier project_id UUID (FK) Associated project channel_id VARCHAR Slack channel ID channel_name VARCHAR Slack channel name created_at TIMESTAMP Mapping creation timestamp

docs.title: Channel Conversation Table
docs.text:
Stores Slack messages from project channels.

These messages are later processed by the Communication Intelligence module.

Column Name Data Type Description message_id UUID (PK) Unique message identifier channel_id VARCHAR Slack channel ID thread_id VARCHAR Slack thread ID user_id UUID (FK) User who sent the message message_text TEXT Message content timestamp TIMESTAMP Message timestamp processed BOOLEAN Whether message has been processed by AI

docs.title: Tasks Table
docs.text:
The Tasks table stores work items assigned to team members. These tasks are automatically extracted from Slack standup communication using the LLM.

Column Name Data Type Description id UUID (PK) Unique identifier for the task content TEXT Description of the task sender_slack_id VARCHAR Slack ID of the user associated with the task project_id UUID (FK) Project to which the task belongs status VARCHAR Task status (Open, In Progress, Completed) priority VARCHAR Task priority (Low, Medium, High) created_at TIMESTAMP Time when the task was created updated_at TIMESTAMP Last update timestamp deleted_at TIMESTAMP Soft delete timestamp

docs.title: Blockers Table
docs.text:
The Blockers table stores issues or obstacles reported by team members during development.

These blockers are detected from Slack communication and tracked for resolution.

Column Name Data Type Description id UUID (PK) Unique identifier for the blocker record content TEXT Description of the blocker sender_slack_id VARCHAR Slack ID of the user who reported the blocker project_id UUID (FK) Project associated with the blocker severity VARCHAR Severity level (Low, Medium, High, Critical) status VARCHAR Status of the blocker (Open, In Progress, Resolved) created_at TIMESTAMP Time when blocker was created updated_at TIMESTAMP Last update timestamp deleted_at TIMESTAMP Soft delete timestamp

docs.title: Daily Updates Table
docs.text:
The Daily Updates table stores daily progress updates extracted from Slack standup communication.

These updates help track team progress and project activity.

Column Name Data Type Description id UUID (PK) Unique identifier for the update content TEXT Daily update content sender_slack_id VARCHAR Slack ID of the sender project_id UUID (FK) Associated project summary TEXT LLM-generated summary of the update created_at TIMESTAMP Update creation time updated_at TIMESTAMP Last update timestamp deleted_at TIMESTAMP Soft delete timestamp

docs.title: Introduction
docs.text:
Modern software development teams rely on multiple tools for project management, communication, and documentation. Important information about tasks, project progress, discussions, and decisions is often scattered across different platforms such as Slack, meeting tools, and project trackers.

The AI Project Manager is designed to address this challenge by providing an intelligent system that integrates communication, project collaboration, and knowledge management into a unified platform.

The system uses Artificial Intelligence to analyze team communication, manage tasks and timelines, assist in meetings, and automatically generate documentation. By doing so, it helps development teams improve productivity, maintain project transparency, and reduce manual effort.

docs.title: AI Project Manager Overview
docs.text:
The AI Project Manager is composed of several intelligent modules that work together to manage project communication and workflow.

Key features include:

  • Project and Collaboration Management Enables teams to create projects, invite collaborators, and manage project workspaces.

  • Task and Timeline Discussion Management Tracks discussions related to tasks, deadlines, and project milestones.

  • Slack and Communication Intelligence Analyzes Slack conversations to extract tasks, blockers, and project updates.

  • Intelligent Meeting Management Helps teams manage meetings, capture discussions, and generate summaries.

  • Auto Documentation Automatically converts discussions and project insights into structured documentation.

These features enable the AI Project Manager to act as an intelligent assistant for software teams.

docs.title: Core Modules of AI Project Manager
docs.text:
The system consists of multiple modules working together to support project management activities.

  1. Project and Collaboration Management
  2. Task and Timeline Discussion Management
  3. Communication Intelligence
  4. Intelligent Meeting Management
  5. Auto Documentation
  6. Knowledge Base and AI Chatbot

Each module processes different types of project information and contributes to building a centralized knowledge system.

docs.title: End-to-End System Workflow
docs.text: The AI Project Manager follows a structured workflow to manage project communication and generate insights.

docs.title: Step 1: Project Creation
docs.text:
An administrator creates a project within the platform and selects a Slack workspace for communication.

The system then creates a dedicated project channel where team members collaborate.

docs.title: Step 2: Team Collaboration
docs.text:
Developers, project managers, and freelancers are invited to join the workspace through email invitations.

Team members communicate through Slack channels, discussing tasks, timelines, and project updates.

docs.title: Step 3: Communication Capture
docs.text: Slack Events API sends communication events to the backend system. All messages and conversations are stored in the message database.

docs.title: Step 4: Communication Intelligence Processing
docs.text:
The Communication Intelligence module analyzes conversations using AI models.

The system extracts:

  • Tasks
  • Blockers
  • Project updates
  • Important decisions

docs.title: Step 5: Urgent Issue Detection
docs.text:
The system also detects urgent issues such as:

  • Production failures
  • Deployment problems
  • Critical bugs

When detected, alerts are generated for the team.

docs.title: Step 6: Knowledge Base Generation
docs.text:
All extracted insights are stored in a knowledge base which organizes project information in a structured format.

This knowledge base enables future search and AI-driven responses.

docs.title: Step 7: Intelligent Meeting Management
docs.text:
The system supports meeting discussions by summarizing key points and storing them as structured meeting records.

This helps teams maintain a clear record of decisions and action items.

docs.title: Step 8: Auto Documentation
docs.text:
The Auto Documentation module automatically generates documentation from project discussions, extracted insights, and meeting summaries.

This reduces the need for manual documentation.

docs.title: Step 9: AI Chatbot Assistance
docs.text:
Developers and project managers can query the system through an AI chatbot.

The chatbot retrieves information from the knowledge base and provides intelligent answers related to the project.

docs.title: Benefits of the AI Project Manager
docs.text:
The system provides several benefits for development teams:

  • Improved visibility into project communication
  • Early detection of blockers and urgent issues
  • Automated documentation of project activities
  • Centralized knowledge management
  • Intelligent project insights through AI

By integrating communication intelligence with project management capabilities, the AI Project Manager helps teams work more efficiently and maintain better control over their projects.
